body.title: Rebuild the extension, report the size delta, confirm the sweep
body.summary: The shipping act, which must come last: rebuild and reinstall the extension (esbuild bundle + VSIX) and report the size delta against the 241,713-byte baseline — the figure alternative a3 was rejected on, and therefore the number that proves the DOM-construction route kept its central promise. Also restate which artefact had to be rebuilt for which change, since conflating the daemon rebuild (t1) with the extension rebuild makes a correct change look broken.
acceptanceChecks: The extension is rebuilt and the VSIX size delta is COMPUTED from the two artefacts and reported — never typed from memory
The delta is a few KB, not megabytes, confirming the DOM-construction route avoided a3's >10x cost
The full plugin sweep passes and its count is stated, as is the docs-review suite's
The daemon rebuild (t1) and the extension rebuild (this task) are both named in the completion note, with which change each one ships

tests.name: the full plugin sweep passes and its count is stated, as is the docs-review suite's
